subject: Promoted helper diagnostic terminator is a multichar literal
body: Read-only additional concrete bug: new gpu/metal/nord2_texture_resources.h lines998,1028,1067 currently contain a TWO-backslash-zero character literal in source, not the one-backslash NUL escape. Python repr shows why[i] line with four backslashes in representation. C treats this as a multichar constant and truncates to character0, not byte zero; diagnostic strings are not NUL terminated. Replace with actual C NUL escape or integer0. Host -Wall -Werror should catch it. Earlier clump/Cube/ETC2/swizzle/zero-span notes remain applicable in promoted header as of this read; review against board before testing/publishing readiness.
